title: Uncommon Words from Two Sentences
description: A sentence is a string of single-space-separated lowercase words. A word is uncommon if it appears exactly once in one of the sentences and does not appear at all in the other sentence. Given two sentences `s1` and `s2`, return a list of all uncommon words in any order.
constraints: s1 and s2 consist of lowercase English letters and single spaces separating words.
hints: A word is uncommon iff its combined frequency across both s1 and s2 equals 1.
Count all words from s1 and s2 in a single hash map and collect those with count == 1.

examples.explanation: "sweet" and "sour" each appear once across both sentences.
"apple" appears twice in s1, so only "banana" is uncommon.
Every word appears twice, so no word is uncommon.
